referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Waste-specific emissions from lignite spoil leachate. Short- and long-term emissions to groundwater from rainwater infiltration leaching. Leaching by lateral groundwater flow not included.; Geography: Data represents a worldwide average. Generic water infiltration rate according to weighted mean of major sites of coal spoil production in the world.
referenceFunction.localName: Disposal, spoil from coal mining, in surface landfill
referenceFunction.name: Disposal, spoil from coal mining, in surface landfill

geography.text: Data represents a worldwide average. Generic water infiltration rate according to weighted mean of major sites of coal spoil production in the world.

technology.text: Mechanically stable and revegetated coal spoil backfill or heap.

timePeriod.text: Average coal spoil composition and leachate concentrations adopted from available lignite spoil data from literature references. Transfer coefficients from prospective model, specific to coal spoil sites.

representativeness.productionVolume: Approx. 22'240 Mio t/a spoil tailings generation
representativeness.samplingProcedure: Disposal model based on observed leachate concentrations in literature. Extrapolated to 60'000 years heeding chemical characteristics. Initial spoil composition from various literature sources.
